title: Data Models and Routing
summary: This module defines core data structures for API responses, manages application routing, handles session state, and provides utilities for file processing and global interface extensions.

nodes.label: Model Data Structure
nodes.title: Model API Response Structure
nodes.description: Defines the structure for API responses containing a list of models, including a utility for converting nested data.

nodes.label: Settings Data Structure
nodes.title: Settings API Response Structure
nodes.description: Defines the structure for API responses containing application settings, including a utility for converting nested data.

nodes.label: Health Status Data Structure
nodes.title: Health API Response Structure
nodes.description: Defines the structure for API responses indicating the application's health status (healthy/unhealthy).

nodes.label: Model Upstream Status
nodes.title: Model Upstream Status Response
nodes.description: Defines the structure for API responses indicating if a model is stale or has an associated error.

nodes.label: Route Type Definitions
nodes.title: File-based Route Type Definitions
nodes.description: Provides TypeScript interface definitions for file-based routing, mapping full paths and IDs to route components.

nodes.label: Application Root Component
nodes.title: Main Application Root Component
nodes.description: The top-level React component that renders the main application layout and initiates global data fetches like settings and cloud status.

nodes.label: Session State Management
nodes.title: Browser Session State Accessor
nodes.description: Provides a utility function to access and manage browser session storage, with a fallback in case sessionStorage is unavailable.

nodes.label: Global Window Interface
nodes.title: Extended Global Window Interface
nodes.description: Extends the global Window object with custom properties for webview interactions, drag functionality, and menu operations.

nodes.label: File Validation & Processing
nodes.title: File Validation and Byte Processing
nodes.description: Asynchronously validates a list of files against specified options and reads valid files into Uint8Array format, reporting any errors.

nodes.label: API Client
nodes.title: API Client Module
nodes.description: Handles communication with the backend API, including fetching settings and cloud status.

nodes.label: User Interface
nodes.title: User Interface Module
nodes.description: The main module for the application's graphical user interface.

nodes.label: Webview Host Integration
nodes.title: Webview Host Integration Module
nodes.description: Manages the integration and communication between the webview and the native host application.

groups.label: API Data Structures
groups.title: API Response Data Structures
groups.description: Defines the TypeScript interfaces and classes for various API responses, ensuring type safety and data consistency.

groups.label: Routing & Navigation
groups.title: Application Routing and Session Management
groups.description: Components responsible for defining application routes, rendering the main layout, and managing user session state.

groups.label: Core Utilities & Interfaces
groups.title: Global Utilities and Interface Extensions
groups.description: Provides utility functions for file handling and extends the global browser interface for application-specific functionalities.
